nom: TruSkin Vitamin C Super Serum for Face

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports no problems using the product, alongside reduced dark spots and hyperpigmentation.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry, including some who are also sensitive, report using the product every other day to a few times a week without issues, with visible fading of dark spots over several weeks.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer, drier than usual due to cold weather with uneven tone and some acne, reports an initial breakout followed by improved texture, tone and faded marks after gradually building up frequency over about two months.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers report good tolerance and reduced dark spots or improved texture with reduced-frequency use, but some report burning, redness or a bad breakout, especially on the neck or when used more often than the directed two to three times a week.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s through 70s report firmer-feeling, smoother skin with less noticeable fine lines and wrinkles after several weeks of consistent use, several noting they stopped wearing foundation.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers in their 40s to 70s report firmer skin and visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles within three to eight weeks of consistent use; at least one reviewer using it twice daily for two months reports no noticeable improvement.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers pre-empt dryness by following with a moisturizer and report no issues, while others, especially with daily use, experience drying or flaking that they attribute to the retinol content and resolve by cutting back to the directed two to three times a week.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers experience burning, stinging or redness, especially in the first week, on the neck specifically, or when used more often than directed; others, including some with sensitive skin, report no redness at all.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, hyperpigmentation or acne marks within a few weeks to a few months of regular use; one reviewer reports no change at all in sun spots or pore size after two months of twice-daily use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention acne report fewer breakouts or faded scars over time; a couple describe an initial purging phase with new blackheads or zits, and one reports a bad breakout later attributed to using the product more often than the directed two to three times a week.

aspects.libelle: Cap or dropper frequently arrives cracked or broken
Thicker, creamy texture rather than a thin watery serum
Absorbs quickly without greasy or tacky residue
Small bottle empties faster than expected
Customer service readily replaces or refunds defective bottles

extraits.texte: I gave this 2 months of 2x a day regular use before writing a review. I bought this in hopes of evening my skin and softening acne scars, sun spots. As you can see from the photo, this serum didn’t help at all. I purchased it because it had glowing review on Amazon. None of my sun spots faded despite a well regimented regime of using this twice a day every day after toner and gentle skin cleanser. You are better off saving your money for a dermatologist recommended cream than wasting on these serums that do nothing besides basic skin hydration. My pore size remained the same as well.

As stated in some of the other reviews, this stuff is pretty harsh. I noticed that it stings my face, but it didn't bother me too much and it made me feel like it was working. :) I am a skincare fanatic and regularly use strong products that contain acids and retinol on my face, but I usually forget to bring them down onto my neck. This product did not have any bad effects on my face, but when I used it on my neck, it burned extremely bad and I was left with raw red patches. You can see it in the pictures I have posted. These pics were taken two days after putting the serum on my neck. That being said, I will probably keep using it on my face since it seems to be able to tolerate it better than my neck. To be safe, I plan to cut back to using it only two or three times a week. I do think this is an effective product, but I would be EXTREMELY cautious using it if your skin is not used to acids and/or retinol. I would also recommend washing it off if the stinging does not go away in about a minute because it is probably actually burning your skin at that point, much like a chemical burn. I would absolutely avoid this product if you have sensitive skin. So just be very careful with this stuff and always research the ingredients you are putting on your body!

I bought the product to help fade dark spots on my face. It has lightened the dark spots. It did take several weeks to notice a difference. I have dry and sensitive skin, and I use it every other day with no issues.

This picture is after a month of use. I’ve had hyperpigmentation for 10 years now from laying on the sun while on antibiotics when I was in my 20s - not smart. The dark spots are fading and significant lighter. Several of the spots and freckles have completely vanished. Now, for the large hyperpigmentation areas on both cheeks, I hope it continues to fade. Again, this pic is only after a month. Visible results in 1 month is amazing for a product under $30.00. This serum has retinol which can cause dry skin. I use a serum before I apply it and a moisturizing serum and moisturizer after to avoid drying out and flaking. It’s worked - my skin is not dry or flaking and has a glow. Super silky product and feels smooth on skin, it’s refreshing. No smell, and didn’t make my face red. It seems to absorb well, but I use a hairdryer in between each product u use to open my pores with the warm air and dries the product faster and absorbs quicker. It application, just like all serums. Very pleased and I am excited to see more results in a month from now. If you struggle with stubborn skin damage like me (mine is really bad) I know how freaking frustrating it is when you just want it gone! I thought my face would stay this dark and get darker for the rest of my life. I have a little bit of hope now that it will mostly go away one day if I keep following a skin routine. I have never strictly followed a skin care routine. Now I religiously have for a month and I’m already seeing lightening.

So I wanted to add a serum into my routine, just turning 30, my skin took some kind of nose dive and broke out pretty bad. I needed soemthing with all the right things in one bottle. I have acne, acne Mark's, combo skin but bc of it being colder my skin is dryer, and I have uneven skin tone. We all have those moments where we look in the mirror and not like what we see! I took to Amazon like I always do and tried to find something worth my $$$. I saw this product and saw how many reviews it had, and lots of good ones. Though some bad ones scared me, but everyone's skin is different. I went from using this stuff 2x a week for 2 weeks, then went to 3x a week for 2 weeks. Now I use it everyday, but only at night. Build up your skins tolerance! Even though it is moisturizing, it can make the skin dry bc of the retinol. So make sure you have a good moisturizer. But over time, my skin is softer, less texture, tone is more evened out, my Mark's have faded a lot since starting this and my acne has improved so much. It doesnt happen over night! I've been using this for almost 2 months! I even noticed that if I get one of those under the skin zits, this stuff will shrink it better than some spot treatment from the store. My skin did NOT purge! No breakouts from this product. I am still new to serums and vitamin C, and what not to use with it, but whatever I'm doing is working for my skin, and I couldnt be happier. If you're thinking about trying this stuff, do it. Because Erica checks

extraits.titre: Trueskin really cares about their customers
extraits.texte: *Please read the entire review before making a decision* I have never gotten this type of reaction on my skin. I see there are a lot of great reviews and it seems to work for some people but the reaction on my skin was terrible. I am embarrassed to go out looking this way. Update: 9/14/2022 Trueskin really cares about their customers. After I wrote my review a representative contacted me to find out more about my skin type and concerns. They suggested other products that would best work for me. I also discovered that I did not use the product as directed so this could also have been a reason for my break out. I am seeing a dermatologist this week so hopefully they can prescribe something that will clear the acne soon. I appreciate the concern of the company. They showed they really care about their customers. Once my skin is better I still would love to use their products. They have great reviews and I see the great results on other women. So make sure you use the product as directed which is only 2 - 3 drops 2 - 3 times a week to avoid any bad reactions.

Aside from the great smell, this stuff has seemed to really help my skin. I suffer from dry, sensitive skin, so everything irritates it. This line has helped with the texture of my skin and made it much softer. It also doesn’t cause much irritation which scented products usually do.
